artboards.title: Trackside — phone in the hot pits

annotations.text:
The thesis.

Nothing here is a repaint. Same cards, same tokens, same dark theme — those are new and consistent. What changes is what sits above them.

Every artboard uses the real design system: #0a0a0a ink, #d91e1e signal red, 12px card radius, 20px card padding, the app's own type ramp.

Invoices is the test case.

It shipped, then got reported as missing twice — the mark-paid and delete controls sat behind a "5 lines" toggle, inside a panel, inside a tab.

Here it is a page with its own address. Nothing was rewritten to make that true.

Race control is where the nesting is worst today: eight console tabs, plus six sibling pages (timing, incidents, penalties, bulletins, broadcast, gate) that live outside the tab strip.

Gate is currently not linked from the console at all.

As a rail they are all just entries.
Cheapest stage, biggest immediate win: ⌘K can ship on its own, on top of today's structure, and it fixes findability for all 45 pages without moving any of them.

Trackside is a different job from the desktop console: gloves, sunlight, one hand, no signal.

Bottom bar, 44px minimum targets, scan in the centre. No fake status bar — the real one paints over it.
